correctness.rationale: Strict-source distance separation and radius-interval covering for length-k schedules imply exactly two repeated incidences because k²-(k²-2)=2. Anchoring unique radius-zero center and clockwise ordering radii yields deficits t_j>=0 summing two, endpoints t0,t_(k-1)<=1 and interior <=2; all such configurations obey center distance constraints via path gap estimates. Adjacent source slide transfers a deficit unit between neighboring gaps, preserving circular radius order. On fixed order the two-particle graph connects, and one full circulation shifts anchor one step, so each order is a component. Counting gap vectors gives (k²+k-4)/2, degrees 2/3/4 and edges formula. Fresh C++ brute-force direct graph enumeration k=3,4,5 reproduced totals 56/672/7176, 2/6/24 components and degree histograms and edges, without using gap encoding.
residual_risks: No claims for k<3, farther deficits, nonstrict ignition or source jumps.
